newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo in 5-yr power deal with Vattenfall.
newsitem.headline: Volvo in 5-yr power deal with Vattenfall.

text.p: Swedish vehicle manufacturer AB Volvo on Friday said it had signed a five-year agreement with Swedish state-owned power company Vattenfall for electricity to its facilities in Sweden.
The agreement is worth about 1.3 billion crowns.
Under the agreement Vattenfall and its distributors will deliver electric power to about 25 Volvo facilities during the next five years.
The agreement also includes cooperation in the energy field, Volvo said in a statement.
The Volvo group's consumption of energy amounts to about 0.8 percent of total annual consumption in Sweden.
